key: SEACREST: So, you wish to enter my garden?
en: SEACREST: So, you wish to enter my garden?
ja: シークレスト: して　わたしの庭に　入りたいと?

key: Once, I let just anyone in.
en: Once, I let just anyone in.
ja: かつては　誰でも　入れていた

key: But then the careless people of this city ruined it.
en: But then the careless people of this city ruined it.
ja: だが　この街の　心ない者たちが　台なしにした
君は　あの者たちとは　ちがうのかね?

key: Can you prove to me that you are of higher caliber?
en: Can you prove to me that you are of higher caliber?
ja: 君が　より高い品格の持ち主だと　証明できるかね?

key: SEACREST: Then show me your dedication.
en: SEACREST: Then show me your dedication.
ja: シークレスト: では　その心がけを　見せてもらおう
シークレスト: 十分に　見せてもらった

key: Please treat my garden with respect.
en: Please treat my garden with respect.
ja: わたしの庭を　大切に　あつかってくれたまえ
シークレスト: 分かってくれて　ありがたい

key: This is one of the nicest complexes in all of Peridot, and it's all thanks to Mr. Seacrest's wonderful garden.
en: This is one of the nicest complexes in all of Peridot, and it's all thanks to Mr. Seacrest's wonderful garden.
ja: ここは　ペリドットでも　いちばん立派な団地なんだ。シークレストさんの　すばらしい庭のおかげだよ
シークレストさんって　すごいんだ!

key: When the city restoration got underway, he took up leading the gardening in places all across the city!
en: When the city restoration got underway, he took up leading the gardening in places all across the city!
ja: 街の復興が始まったとき　街じゅうの庭づくりを　率先して　引き受けたんだよ!

key: SEACREST: Please treat my humble garden with respect.
en: SEACREST: Please treat my humble garden with respect.
ja: シークレスト: この　ささやかな庭を　大切に　あつかってくれたまえ
